conditions_or_holds: No shared-core promotion from lexical overlap, convenience, or one-domain use; require crop-and-livestock evidence.
Route by semantic function; no route approval implies row identity, hierarchy, mapping, publication, or one-row-one-concept conversion.
Apply accepted ADR 0052 boundaries; field and lookup records do not become aom-core concepts by default; implementation remains gated.
Preserve supporting-resource lineage; promote independent identities only through row evidence and global collision review.
Use wave labels 0 through 7; revise practice/outcome wave to cross-domain routing; keep ADR 0049 separate from unrelated work.
Report whole-resource denominator; source-row counts or one-module depth never establish whole-AOM completeness.
Preserve source and identifiers; never infer one row equals one concept, reuse identity by label, delete published IDs, or hand-edit distributions.
Retain site_list publication hold, ssa_feedsdb exclusion, and scio - Custom Terms provenance hold; no acceptance implies public release.
